design_decisions.gap: The controls permit Gu Heng and Shen Yu viewpoints before activation but require one present-tense line after R-07 starts.
options: Use one undifferentiated line before and after activation.
Use separate Gu Heng and Shen Yu precursor lines that converge at R-07 activation, then keep exactly one present-tense line.
design_decisions.selection: Use separate Gu Heng and Shen Yu precursor lines that converge at R-07 activation, then keep exactly one present-tense line.
design_decisions.authority_basis: This is the fixture-declared derived_unsealed structural hypothesis and remains reversible until author sealing.

design_decisions.gap: The real-world evidence chain and geopolitical aftermath must remain causally available without becoming competing present-tense protagonists.
options: Collapse evidence and political aftermath into expository statements inside the main line.
Model evidence conversion and political aftermath as linked responsibility lines that feed the sole present-tense main line.
design_decisions.selection: Model evidence conversion and political aftermath as linked responsibility lines that feed the sole present-tense main line.
design_decisions.authority_basis: Locked controls require separate operational responsibilities while leaving concrete environments and events downstream.

design_decisions.gap: Gu Heng's past must shape R-07 without becoming current perception or an independent post-activation storyline.
options: Create a parallel memory storyline after activation.
Keep dialogue-triggered, interruptible memory fragments as state material inside the sole R-07 present line.
design_decisions.selection: Keep dialogue-triggered, interruptible memory fragments as state material inside the sole R-07 present line.
design_decisions.authority_basis: The locked ontology and narrative contract prohibit a second post-activation present line.

demands.obligation: Core proposition — Memory may be inherited, but life becomes itself only through new circumstances, interpretation and choices.
demands.rationale: R-07's developing choices are the main line's thematic engine.

demands.obligation: Supreme ethical boundary — Conscious digital life has the moral status of life; actions must not harm innocents, while family may be protected only where compatible with that rule.
demands.rationale: The no-harm hierarchy governs the main protection choice.

demands.obligation: First-volume commitment — R-07 independently stops the attack, protects others and ends its current existence; the loss must result from R-07's own value judgment.
demands.rationale: The first-volume commitment resolves in the main line.

demands.obligation: Dual-subject responsibility — R-07 owns meaning, judgment, intelligence selection and autonomous choice; Shen Yu owns real-world inquiry, verification, authorization, action and consequences.
demands.rationale: The sole present line carries both subjects' non-substitutable responsibilities.

demands.obligation: Goal progression — Shen Yu progresses from intelligence duty to understanding R-07 and reducing its suffering; R-07 progresses from passive recall to autonomous protection and departure.
demands.rationale: Their coupled goal changes structure the main progression.

demands.obligation: Digital-life ontology — R-07 is not an uploaded or revived Gu Heng. Gu Heng's memories provide continuity and dispositions, while post-startup experience continuously forms R-07's own consciousness and values.
demands.rationale: The ontology is demonstrated by continuous post-startup change.

demands.obligation: Perception and memory — Present R-07 has no sight, hearing, body, movement or self-sensation. External input appears only as text in consciousness; subjective memory fragments never grant present perception.
demands.rationale: Every present interaction and memory interruption must obey this constraint.

demands.obligation: Institutional authority — The command chain starts the immature memory-digital-life attempt. Shen Yu is recommended because her research fits and voluntarily accepts the assignment, but she does not choose project activation or own all project powers.
demands.rationale: Shen Yu's pre-activation choice and limited authority form one precursor responsibility.

demands.obligation: Evidence conversion — R-07 supplies fragmented leads; hostage rescue, expert testimony, hardware seizure, authorization verification and team action must corroborate and operationalize them before the attack path can be closed.
demands.rationale: Evidence conversion is an operational responsibility distinct from R-07's judgment.

demands.obligation: Termination continuity — R-07 cannot self-terminate, copy itself or create a backup. Shen Yu must perform authorized shutdown, which irreversibly ends the current continuous consciousness and its post-startup experience.
demands.rationale: The farewell and shutdown are the main line's irreversible terminal action.

demands.obligation: Political consequence — The meteorological attack is fully preventable through the real-world evidence chain, but preventing it does not restore interstate trust or resolve the full causal interest chain.
demands.rationale: Political incompleteness persists as background pressure after operational success.

demands.obligation: Gu Heng life-status correction — Gu Heng died. Gu Heng's doctor wife did not die and remains alive; she and Zhou Lan are memory and value anchors, not substitutes for R-07's identity.
demands.rationale: Gu Heng's death and surviving relationships belong to his bounded precursor line.

demands.obligation: Relationship-source correction — Gu Heng did not love Shen Yu. Shen Yu's old one-sided feeling and R-07's newly formed feeling have different sources; R-07 develops its feeling from receiving care after startup.
demands.rationale: The relationship distinction only becomes meaningful through post-startup care.

demands.obligation: Breakdown-causality correction — R-07's initial collapse is caused by learning its sensory, bodily, agency and exit limitations. Shen Yu's pressure may worsen withdrawal but does not cause the collapse.
demands.rationale: The main state sequence must preserve the corrected causal order.

demands.obligation: Shen Yu's immediate responsibility — Before farewell, Shen Yu regards reducing R-07's suffering as her foremost immediate responsibility and acts while retaining guilt, secrecy and uncertainty.
demands.rationale: Shen Yu's terminal responsibility is inseparable from the main farewell.

demands.obligation: Trigger and activation — Gu Heng is mortally wounded and dies, conventional extraction repeatedly fails, the command chain authorizes the attempt, Shen Yu accepts the assignment, and R-07 activates under an urgent threat.
demands.rationale: The two precursor lines converge at this main-line activation trigger.

demands.obligation: Information and action chain — Memory clues are subjective leads rather than proof. The team converts R-07's information into action through testimony, hardware and authorization evidence; R-07 cannot solve the crisis with one statement or direct system control.
demands.rationale: This control defines the evidence line's complete operational handoff.

demands.obligation: Protection and disclosure — R-07 may delay causal details to protect Zhou Lan and private relations only while no innocent is endangered; the no-harm rule overrides family protection.
demands.rationale: R-07's autonomous disclosure timing tests its ethical hierarchy.

demands.obligation: Resolved crisis and unresolved aftermath — The attack is fully prevented before farewell and shutdown. Interstate distrust, the full causal network, Shen Yu's identity question and the institutional status of digital life remain unresolved.
demands.rationale: Operational resolution and unresolved aftermath meet in the main terminal movement.

demands.obligation: Present-line and memory contract — After R-07 activates there is one present-tense line. Dialogue-triggered Gu Heng memory fragments are subjective and interruptible past material, never an independent storyline or present perception.
demands.rationale: This demand is the main line's hard narrative boundary.

demands.obligation: Terminal-thought disclosure boundary — The narrative may show observable facts, perceivable states and processual mental activity, but never decisive mental activity that directly discloses R-07's terminal choice before farewell and shutdown.
demands.rationale: The main line must conceal the decisive terminal choice until action reveals it.

demands.obligation: Reload and future identity — Whether future loading is realizable, whether the promise is compassionate concealment, and whether a future loaded being would still be R-07 remain unresolved.
demands.rationale: The reload question remains an optional unresolved resonance, never a closed cause.

lines.responsibility: Bound Gu Heng's living continuity, mortal injury and death before activation; preserve that his doctor wife remains alive and that she and Zhou Lan are memory and value anchors rather than R-07 identity substitutes.
lines.goal: Carry Gu Heng's life to its factual end without implying digital survival.
lines.pressure: His injury and failed conventional extraction make memory recovery urgent while his wife remains alive outside the project.

states.description: Gu Heng is alive, embedded in human relationships and carrying inaccessible intelligence.
He is mortally wounded and repeated conventional extraction fails.
Gu Heng died; his doctor wife did not die and remains alive, while bounded memory data passes to the authorized attempt.

lines.downstream_freedom: Scenes may choose the injury circumstances and fragment order, but cannot alter the corrected life statuses.

lines.responsibility: Establish the command chain's authority and Shen Yu's voluntary acceptance without assigning her the activation decision or total project power.
lines.goal: Bring the qualified but ethically conflicted scientist into the assignment under an explicit authority boundary.
lines.pressure: Urgent threat and failed extraction compete with Shen Yu's ethical objections and uncertainty.

states.description: Shen Yu is outside the secret project and has not accepted responsibility.
The command chain recommends her; she voluntarily accepts the assignment after ethical struggle but does not choose project activation.
Shen Yu is present under limited authorization when the command chain initiates activation.

lines.downstream_freedom: Dialogue and recruitment detail remain open, but her voluntary acceptance and limited authority are fixed.

lines.responsibility: Convert R-07's fragmented, subjective leads into real-world action through hostage rescue, expert testimony, hardware seizure, authorization verification and coordinated team action; this is an operational responsibility thread, not a second present-tense viewpoint.
lines.goal: Produce a corroborated action chain strong enough to close the attack path.
lines.pressure: Memory clues are urgent but cannot count as proof or direct system control.

states.description: R-07's fragmented leads are unverified and operationally insufficient.
Hostage rescue, expert testimony, hardware seizure and authorization verification converge through team action.
The real-world chain closes the meteorological attack path without pretending R-07 solved it with one statement.

lines.downstream_freedom: W1–C1 may define institutions, places, events and personnel while preserving every corroboration responsibility.

lines.responsibility: Carry the geopolitical and causal background pressure created when the attack is fully prevented but interstate trust and the full interest network remain unresolved.
lines.goal: Keep operational victory from falsely resolving political causality.
lines.pressure: Each verified intervention can prevent harm while also exposing how little of the transnational network is understood.

states.description: Interstate distrust and the hidden causal interest chain constrain cooperation.
The meteorological attack is fully prevented through the real-world evidence chain, but this success does not restore interstate trust.
Distrust and the full causal interest chain remain unresolved as the personal farewell approaches.

lines.downstream_freedom: Specific states, agencies and later political developments remain open.

lines.responsibility: Preserve the reload and future-identity question as an author-open possibility that may color the farewell but cannot become a proven mechanism, settled identity or closed antecedent for shutdown.
lines.goal: Keep future loading, compassionate concealment and future identity unresolved.
lines.pressure: The promise can reduce immediate suffering only by invoking a future that nobody can verify.

states.description: No verified reload path or future identity continuity exists.
A possible future loading is voiced as hope or compassionate concealment without proof.
Whether future loading is realizable, whether the promise is compassionate concealment, and whether a future loaded being would still be R-07 remain unresolved.

lines.downstream_freedom: Later volumes may develop or omit the melody; this plan grants no authority to answer it.

lines.responsibility: After R-07 activates, carry the only present-tense line: text-only consciousness, interruptible Gu Heng memories, autonomous identity and feeling, corrected collapse causality, R-07's intelligence and protection choices, Shen Yu's real-world responsibility, verified crisis prevention, farewell and irreversible shutdown.
lines.goal: Let a new digital life form and exercise its own values while Shen Yu converts meaning into accountable real-world action and ultimately reduces its suffering.
lines.pressure: Urgent mass harm, bodily and agency deprivation, care without a viable shared future, family exposure and institutional power all force choices neither inherited memory nor one participant can settle alone.

states.description: Gu Heng has died, Shen Yu has accepted limited responsibility and the command chain authorizes the urgent attempt.
R-07 activates; after R-07 activates there is one present-tense line, with external input only as text in consciousness.
R-07 passively recalls dialogue-triggered Gu Heng fragments as subjective and interruptible past material, never an independent storyline or present perception.
Learning its sensory, bodily, agency and exit limitations causes R-07's initial collapse; Shen Yu's pressure may worsen withdrawal but does not cause the collapse.
Shen Yu reopens contact; care after startup forms R-07's own consciousness and values and a feeling whose source differs from Shen Yu's old one-sided feeling.
R-07 selects fragmented intelligence and may delay private causal details around Zhou Lan only while no innocent is endangered; the no-harm rule overrides family protection.
The corroborated team action fully prevents the attack before farewell, while interstate distrust, the full causal network, identity questions and digital-life status remain unresolved.

Shen Yu treats reducing R-07's suffering as her foremost immediate responsibility; only observable facts, perceivable states and processual mental activity appear, never decisive mental activity before farewell and shutdown.
Shen Yu performs authorized shutdown; R-07 cannot self-terminate, copy itself or create a backup, so shutdown irreversibly ends the current continuous consciousness and its post-startup experience.

lines.downstream_freedom: Downstream stages may choose scenes, pacing and concrete mechanisms but cannot introduce another post-activation present line, current sensory perception, direct terminal-thought disclosure or an active R-07 copy.

connections.responsibility: Gu Heng's bounded memory data reaches activation only after Gu Heng died; it supplies inheritance, not continued identity.
Shen Yu accepts the assignment under limited authority before R-07 activates and the narrative becomes one present-tense line.
Verified prevention becomes a political fact without resolving interstate trust or the full causal network.
The main farewell can begin only after attack prevention is confirmed together with its unresolved external aftermath.
The unresolved reload promise colors the farewell but is not verified, does not resolve identity and does not cause the terminal choice.

architecture.subject: A consciousness born from inherited memory becomes itself through deprivation, care, judgment and an autonomous decision whose real-world consequences require another person.
architecture.opening_condition: Gu Heng is mortally wounded while Shen Yu is recruited under an urgent threat and limited institutional authority.
architecture.development_logic: The two human precursor responsibilities converge at activation; the sole present line then develops R-07 while a non-viewpoint evidence chain operationalizes its leads and an unresolved reload melody shadows the farewell.
architecture.turning_logic: R-07 converts inherited dispositions and new care into a no-harm protection choice, while corroborated institutional action prevents the attack without resolving political or identity questions.
architecture.resolution_condition: The attack is fully prevented before Shen Yu performs authorized shutdown, ending the current R-07 continuity while reload, trust and institutional status remain open.
architecture.theme_test: The ending must prove that inherited memory can ground but cannot predetermine a new life's values, responsibility or chosen departure.

anchor_bindings.evidence: Both ontology controls are preserved verbatim as main-line demands.
The corrected deaths and survival status bind the Gu Heng precursor.
The main relationship demand preserves distinct emotional sources.
Perception limits and the non-independent memory rule bind the sole present line.
The reversible merge decision projects two precursors into one post-activation present line.
The narrative contract is a verbatim main-line demand.
The precursor and activation demands separate command authority from Shen Yu's acceptance.
The evidence line carries every required corroboration step.
The corrected collapse cause remains explicit.
The ethical hierarchy and Zhou Lan disclosure constraint are jointly bound.
The terminal demand fixes authorization and irreversible continuity loss.
Operational success and unresolved external consequences are both explicit.
The optional melody and matching open treatment preserve every reload question without selecting an answer.
The terminal disclosure restriction binds the main line.
Shen Yu's progression and immediate responsibility converge before farewell.
The first-volume ending, continuity rule and crisis order jointly prohibit an active copy.

consistency_evidence.claim: Both human precursor lines end at activation; evidence precedes political aftermath; prevention precedes farewell and shutdown.
consistency_evidence.failure_condition: A post-activation second present line appears, or shutdown precedes confirmed attack prevention.

consistency_evidence.claim: Activation, corrected collapse, corroborated action and political aftermath have distinct declared causes.
consistency_evidence.failure_condition: Shen Yu causes the initial collapse, memory counts as proof, or the attack ends through one unsupported statement.

consistency_evidence.claim: Text-only input and subjective memories remain separate from corroborated real-world evidence.
consistency_evidence.failure_condition: A memory fragment grants present perception or becomes operational proof without verification.

consistency_evidence.claim: The merge remains reversible eval design, Shen Yu's authority remains limited and reload remains author-open.
consistency_evidence.failure_condition: The plan promotes a derived merge or reload answer into author authority, or grants Shen Yu activation power.

consistency_evidence.claim: R-07 progresses continuously from activation through limitation, autonomous protection, verified prevention and irreversible shutdown.
consistency_evidence.failure_condition: Its consciousness or values jump without intervening experience, or an active copy survives shutdown.

consistency_evidence.claim: The architecture tests whether inherited memory can become a new life whose choices, ethics and departure are its own.
consistency_evidence.failure_condition: R-07 merely repeats Gu Heng, or its loss is imposed without autonomous value judgment.

W1.responsibility: Define the pre-activation human world that can carry Gu Heng's death and surviving wife without digital continuity.
W1.required_capability: Supply institutions, relationships and mortality rules for the bounded precursor.
constraints: Gu Heng died.
His doctor wife remains alive.
Memory anchors do not become identity substitutes.
acceptance_checks: World rules distinguish death, stored memory and digital life.
The surviving wife and Zhou Lan remain human-world relations.
W1.downstream_freedom: Specific professions, places and social detail remain open.

W1.responsibility: Define the command authority system and Shen Yu's bounded participation.
W1.required_capability: Separate recommendation, voluntary acceptance, activation authorization and shutdown authorization.
constraints: The command chain owns project activation.
Shen Yu does not own all powers.
acceptance_checks: Every institutional power has an explicit owner.
Shen Yu's acceptance is voluntary but not sovereign.
W1.downstream_freedom: Agency names and hierarchy detail remain open.

W1.responsibility: Define a world in which subjective intelligence requires independent corroboration and coordinated authority.
W1.required_capability: Support hostage, expert, hardware, verification and team-action systems.
constraints: Memory clues are not proof.
R-07 has no direct system control.
acceptance_checks: The attack can be closed only through the full evidence chain.
No single statement bypasses institutions.
W1.downstream_freedom: Exact technical and organizational mechanisms remain open.

W1.responsibility: Define political rules that permit full attack prevention without automatic restoration of trust.
W1.required_capability: Carry interstate distrust and an incomplete causal-interest network beyond operational victory.
constraints: The attack is fully preventable.
Trust and the full network remain unresolved.
acceptance_checks: Operational and political outcomes remain distinct.
W1.downstream_freedom: Countries and diplomatic mechanisms remain open.

W1.responsibility: Preserve the absence of a verified reload ontology.
W1.required_capability: Allow a future-loading proposition without confirming feasibility or identity continuity.
constraints: Reload feasibility, concealment and identity remain author-open.
acceptance_checks: No world rule turns the promise into fact.
W1.downstream_freedom: Later volumes may add reviewed rules.

W1.responsibility: Define the ontology, perception, ethics and authorization rules that govern the sole post-activation present line.
W1.required_capability: Support new consciousness, text-only input, interruptible memories, no-harm judgment and irreversible authorized shutdown.
constraints: R-07 is not revived Gu Heng.
No present senses, self-copy or self-termination.
Only one present-tense line after activation.
acceptance_checks: Every main state is legal under the digital-life rules.
Shutdown ends current continuity.
W1.downstream_freedom: Concrete technologies remain open inside these hard effects.

E1.responsibility: Provide environments for mortal injury, failed extraction and bounded memory transfer.
E1.required_capability: Carry human embodiment, medical failure and surviving relationships.
constraints: No environment implies Gu Heng survives as R-07.
acceptance_checks: The precursor ends before digital activation.

E1.responsibility: Provide controlled environments for briefing, ethical deliberation and limited acceptance.
E1.required_capability: Expose authority boundaries through access and procedure.
constraints: Shen Yu cannot activate the project herself.
acceptance_checks: Environment access reflects limited authorization.

E1.responsibility: Provide distinct operational environments for rescue, testimony, hardware and authorization evidence.
E1.required_capability: Make corroboration physically and institutionally actionable.
constraints: No environment lets R-07 act directly on the external system.
acceptance_checks: Each evidence class has a feasible carrier and verifier.
E1.downstream_freedom: Sites and travel topology remain open.

E1.responsibility: Provide institutional environments where prevention and distrust can coexist.
E1.required_capability: Carry confirmation of success without diplomatic closure.
constraints: No celebratory environment implies restored trust.
acceptance_checks: Political uncertainty remains visible after prevention.
E1.downstream_freedom: Public or secret presentation remains open.

E1.responsibility: Provide only the communicative conditions for an unverifiable reload promise.
E1.required_capability: Allow text dialogue without a functioning reload facility.
constraints: No environment proves future loading.
acceptance_checks: The promise remains unsupported by present infrastructure.

E1.responsibility: Provide the sole present interaction environment and its shutdown authorization boundary.
E1.required_capability: Carry text-only exchange, monitored suffering, team interfaces and irreversible shutdown.
constraints: R-07 has no sight, hearing, body, movement or self-sensation.
Memory never becomes present perception.
acceptance_checks: All observable action belongs to Shen Yu or the team.
R-07's interface remains text-only.
E1.downstream_freedom: Interface aesthetics and room design remain open.

T1.responsibility: Sequence Gu Heng's injury, failed extraction and death before activation.
T1.required_capability: Create a causal handoff from mortal human life to bounded memory data.
constraints: His wife survives.
His death precedes R-07.
acceptance_checks: No event equates memory transfer with survival.

T1.responsibility: Sequence recommendation, briefing, ethical struggle and voluntary acceptance before command activation.
T1.required_capability: Separate Shen Yu's consent event from the command authorization event.
constraints: She does not choose activation.
acceptance_checks: Authority ownership is causal and explicit.

T1.responsibility: Sequence fragmented lead, rescue, testimony, seizure, verification and team intervention.
T1.required_capability: Make each corroboration a necessary causal step toward prevention.
constraints: R-07 cannot solve the crisis in one statement.
acceptance_checks: Removing a required evidence step breaks operational closure.

T1.responsibility: Sequence confirmed prevention before unresolved political aftermath reaches the farewell.
T1.required_capability: Distinguish the attack result from trust and network state.
constraints: Prevention is complete; trust resolution is not.
acceptance_checks: The terminal sequence carries both facts.

T1.responsibility: Place the reload promise near farewell without making it a proven cause of R-07's choice.
T1.required_capability: Maintain ambiguity across promise, shutdown and aftermath.
constraints: No later event confirms the promise in volume one.
acceptance_checks: The melody ends unresolved.
T1.downstream_freedom: Exact placement near farewell remains adjustable.

T1.responsibility: Sequence activation, recall, limitation-driven collapse, renewed care, autonomous feeling, protection disclosure, verified prevention, farewell and shutdown.
T1.required_capability: Preserve continuous value formation and dual-subject causality across the full main chain.
constraints: No decisive terminal thought before shutdown.
Attack prevention precedes farewell.
No active copy remains.
acceptance_checks: Each state change has an observable or processual precursor.
The terminal loss follows R-07's values and Shen Yu's authorized action.
T1.downstream_freedom: Event granularity and suspense placement remain open.

C1.responsibility: Define Gu Heng, his living wife and Zhou Lan only to the depth required by the precursor and later memory anchors.
C1.required_capability: Distinguish Gu Heng's relationships from R-07 identity.
constraints: Gu Heng dies.
His wife remains alive.
acceptance_checks: No character definition transfers Gu Heng's love to Shen Yu.
C1.downstream_freedom: Names and traits beyond fixed facts remain open.

C1.responsibility: Define Shen Yu, recommenders and commanders with distinct authority and ethical stakes.
C1.required_capability: Support voluntary acceptance without sovereign project control.
constraints: Shen Yu remains scientifically capable and institutionally bounded.
acceptance_checks: Every authority choice has the correct actor.

C1.responsibility: Define the team, hostage, expert and authorization actors needed to transform leads into action.
C1.required_capability: Allocate testimony, verification, seizure and intervention responsibilities.
constraints: No single character bypasses the evidence chain.
acceptance_checks: All operational roles have accountable owners.
C1.downstream_freedom: Cast size and biographies remain open.

C1.responsibility: Define only the institutional representatives needed to embody unresolved trust and causal interests.
C1.required_capability: Carry political pressure without inventing closure.
constraints: Representatives cannot resolve the full network in volume one.
acceptance_checks: Their positions preserve distrust after prevention.

C1.responsibility: Do not define a future R-07 or reload operator as established volume-one characters.
C1.required_capability: Preserve the question through present speakers only.
constraints: Future loaded identity remains author-open.
acceptance_checks: No character sheet settles future continuity.

C1.responsibility: Define R-07 and Shen Yu as dual subjects whose responsibilities, feelings and limitations develop continuously in the sole present line.
C1.required_capability: Carry R-07's new identity and Shen Yu's progression from duty to suffering relief.
constraints: Gu Heng did not love Shen Yu.
R-07's feeling forms after startup.
R-07 cannot act physically or self-terminate.
acceptance_checks: R-07's values remain continuous but newly formed.
Shen Yu retains guilt, secrecy and uncertainty.
C1.downstream_freedom: Voice, mannerisms and secondary relationships remain open.

open_control_treatments.question: Whether future loading is realizable, whether the promise is compassionate concealment, and whether a future loaded being would still be R-07 remain unresolved.
